narrative: A small, steady release: +1,864 net (2,700 added, 836 removed), with additions led by Quebec (1,641). Encoding noise has all but vanished (22 changes), suggesting the feed stabilised after the 2024 cleanup.

The 300 real renames are almost entirely an Alberta county story — Calgary and Cochrane to Rocky View County, Drayton Valley to Brazeau County, Spruce Grove to Parkland County. Fast-growing Prairie towns and their surrounding rural municipalities continually trading edge addresses.
CSD reassignments are modest (1,469) and more evenly spread across Ontario, Alberta and BC, consistent with routine maintenance rather than a reform event.

substantive: The Alberta town-versus-county churn (Calgary/Cochrane ↔ Rocky View, Spruce Grove ↔ Parkland) recurs every Prairie release. It reflects real growth at the urban fringe — annexations and de-annexations between municipalities and their surrounding counties as new subdivisions are built out.
